title: ipfs mcp agent settings: model-list shapes
description: Request and result of the model-list endpoint (mcp-agent-settings-api 1.4). With no base_url the configured backend is queried; when no backend is configured the endpoint answers backend_not_configured. A base_url is a candidate URL under the same rules as test-connection (https, or http on loopback, no credentials). Nothing is persisted.

base_url.description: Optional candidate URL to list models from instead of the configured backend. Same URL rules as test-connection.

kind.description: Backend kind to query as. Absent means openai, or the configured backend's kind when base_url is absent.

id.description: Model identifier as the backend reports it, suitable for backend.model.

models.description: Models the backend reports. Entries may carry backend-specific extra fields, which clients must treat as informational.
